integrity: The equations and earliest public date were checked against arXiv:1109.6569v1. The arXiv subject is Chaotic Dynamics, and MSC 37D45 is the standard mathematical classification for strange attractors and chaotic dynamics; the theorem is classified there because its object is the stationary dynamics of the source's chaotic-reversal flow. The critical generator and residual identities were replayed from the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not prove existence or uniqueness of a chaotic invariant measure.
The RMS relation is stationary rather than pointwise and does not determine reversal frequencies or residence-time laws.
The later fractional-order comparison was available at abstract level only, so an equivalent statement there remains an access-limited residual risk.
Literature indexing is not exhaustive; equivalent statements in differently notated or unindexed low-order dynamo literature remain possible.
title: Exact stationary mode-energy and fluctuation laws in the Gissinger reversal model
